review.reason: The chunk implements Slack-specific analytics and failure attribution. P1.F5.H3 and P1.F6.H1 add tracking and action recognition. P1.F5.H4 and P1.F12.H3/H4 record successful and failed Slack interactions. P1.F12.H2 records failures. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No score assigned. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a list to track unfurled resource kinds, and records the kind when an unfurl succeeds.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Slack app to distinguish which resource types were successfully unfurled, supporting downstream analytics and debugging.

observations.behavior: Adds an else branch that captures an analytics event after the unfurl succeeds, including the list of unfurled kinds and counts.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a successful Slack link unfurl event with metadata, enabling PostHog to track and report on this specific Slack app behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds support for extracting action IDs from block accessories, not just the block itself.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Slack app to recognize and route actions embedded in accessory blocks, potentially expanding supported Slack message interactions.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the definition or implementation of the `capture_slack_event` function, so the exact mechanism and destination of the telemetry cannot be verified. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function `_link_failed` that records a Slack user link failure and redirects to settings, while preserving the Slack user ID and PostHog user ID for attribution.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a failure event; without the implementation, the destination and schema are unknown.

observations.behavior: Replaces a generic settings redirect with a call to `_link_failed` when the Slack OAuth flag is off, preserving the Slack user ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the recorded reason for a failed link attempt from a generic redirect to a specific failure reason, while retaining the Slack user ID for attribution.

observations.behavior: Replaces a generic settings redirect with a call to `_link_failed` when the Slack team does not match the expected team, preserving the Slack user ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the recorded reason for a failed link attempt from a generic redirect to a specific failure reason, while retaining the Slack user ID for attribution.
